architecture.decision: FG-9 composes existing ForgeGreen/server mechanisms rather than building a parallel optimization engine, per the phase's own instruction.
architecture.candidateA: Composes the ALREADY ACTIVE, already-certified FG-1C DuplicateActionSupervisor (packages/server/src/duplicate-suppression.ts) — FG-9 introduces zero new suppression logic and zero new execution-path risk; it wraps already-happening behavior into the new decision/receipt provenance framework.
architecture.candidatesBCD: Pure, tested detector functions over already-available evidence shapes (context-page transmission identity, optional-prefetch flags, ForgeVerify-confirmed validity) — implemented and exercised via deterministic/adversarial fixtures, not wired into live execution this phase.

implementation.runtimeIntegrationPoint: AgentRuntime.persistForgeGreenSustainabilityReceipt (packages/server/src/agent-runtime.ts), in its own isolated try/catch positioned AFTER the FG-8/FG-8R sustainability receipt is already built and saved, so an FG-9 failure can never mask an otherwise-successful measurement

authorityBoundaries.grantedThisPhase: Narrow: may record (and, for Candidate A only, wrap the already-active suppression of) duplicate read-only tool dispatches. No other resource-control surface is active.
evidence: packages/eight-bit, packages/router, packages/workflow, packages/forge-zero: zero files modified this phase.
createOptimizationDecision (optimization-decision.ts) structurally refuses status APPLIED for any kind whose resolved policy mode is not ACTIVE_SAFE — a code-level, not documentation-level, boundary.
fg9-privacy-authority.test.ts §34-37: no field on any decision/receipt matches a model-selection/approval/verification-verdict/completion-verdict shape (key-absence assertion).

fg9-unsafe-mutating.test.ts: proven directly against the REAL FG-1C DuplicateActionSupervisor that write_file/edit_file/run_command (installs/deployments run via run_command) can never be suppressed/cached.

The full packages/server/test suite (461 tests, real AgentRuntime, mission/delivery/parallel/steering, routing/verification/approval/completion flows) passes unchanged after the live Candidate A wiring.

preventedWorkAccounting.rule: Only attributable, reconstructable counterfactuals are counted — never a rounded/guessed figure (unchanged FG-8 rule).
